title: India A knocked out of Asia Cup Rising Stars as Sri Lanka A chase 318 with two centuries
dek: Sineth Jayawardena and Lasith Croospulle hit hundreds in Doha as Sri Lanka A won the first semi-final by eight wickets with 51 balls to spare.
author: Declaration Desk
body:
India A are out of the Asia Cup Rising Stars after Sri Lanka A chased down 318 with eight wickets and 51 balls to spare in the first semi-final at West End Park in Doha on Thursday, according to the BCCI match page.

India A, captained by Tilak Varma, won the toss, batted and made 317 for eight in their 50 overs. Abhishek Sharma top-scored with 78 off 63 balls, Shahbaz Ahmed finished unbeaten on 54 off 48 and Varma made 53 off 66. Sri Lanka A reached 318 for two in 41.3 overs. Sineth Jayawardena made 105 off 70 balls and was named player of the match, and Lasith Croospulle scored 116 off 107 before Harshit Rana had him caught by Rinku Singh. Nishan Madushka, unbeaten on 58, and captain Pavan Rathnayake, 31 not out off 16 balls, finished the chase.

India A had finished second in their group behind Pakistan A. Sri Lanka A will play the final on Sunday, 29 November, at 3.30 pm IST, against the winner of Friday's second semi-final between Pakistan A and Bangladesh A.
